Chapter 329: Chapter 21: The Sixth Shuttle (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 329: Chapter 21: The Sixth Shuttle (Subscribe please)_2

Be aware, the Heiyuan Clan has Ninth Rank beings sitting at the top, and not just one.

“Which two battlefields of different species should we choose this time…”

To verify his suspicion, Lin Yuan intended to send both the Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit to try it out simultaneously.

“Let’s go with these two battlefields of different species.”

After considering for a moment, the criteria Lin Yuan used to select the battlefields of different species primarily revolved around the existence of an eternal spatial rift.

Without an eternal spatial rift, it’s impossible to speed up the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force, which would significantly reduce Lin Yuan’s gains.

...

Secondly, the intensity of the war between human civilization and different species on this battlefield cannot be too high.

Out of the more than two million battlefields of different species opened by human civilization, each has a different situation.

On some battlefields, human evolvers and different species are fiercely antagonistic, and on such battlefields, it’s simply not possible to stay beside an eternal spatial rift for long.

You can barely stay for a moment before the different species come attacking.

“Go.”

Lin Yuan’s thought flickered.

The Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit stepped out from within him.

Whoosh.

Two dark cosmic ships appeared.

The Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit piloted the ships, heading towards the Star Platform outside the Chikun Main Star.

The Thirteen Peaks area, where Lin Yuan was located, is one of the most flourishing areas of Chikun Main Star, with numerous ships taking off at every moment.

As the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks, even if Lin Yuan didn’t announce it, a large number of evolvers would naturally come to him for allegiance.

And all of this, Lin Yuan left to Fang Qing to manage.

…..

“The number of practitioners on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan glanced over and noticed that the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries practicing the First Tier Chapter had skyrocketed to several times what it was half a year ago.

“It seems the videos I released are quite useful.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. He had expended quite a bit of energy producing those videos.

But as long as there is a yield, it’s all worthwhile.

“Who knows where the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter will rank on the Chikun Evolution Rankings once it’s rolled out…”

Lin Yuan was somewhat expectant.

Currently, Lin Yuan had only started the Seventh Rank Chapter, and there was still some distance before it could be fully developed.

However.

It was foreseeable that the Seventh Rank Chapter would have a transformative effect on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, impacting it even more significantly than the time Lin Yuan completely revised the path, freeing it from the confines of Taiyin and Taiyang.

Because this Seventh Rank Chapter, theoretically, could give rise to an inner world.

Of course.

Lin Yuan was also aware.

It would be difficult for other Martial Arts Evolutionaries to create an inner world in the Seventh Rank Chapter; it requires understanding nine hundred and sixty-five basic spatial models during the Sixth Rank and selecting a path that is sufficiently perfect.

For instance.

If a Martial Arts Evolutionary had chosen the Power of Gold as their path at the Second Layer,

they would delve into understanding the Golden Rules in the Third and Fourth Rank.

But by the Sixth Rank, even if this Martial Arts Evolutionary had understood the nine hundred and sixty-five spatial models, they could not open up an inner world.

Because the Golden Rules are too simplistic, nowhere near as perfect and complete as the Taiji Dao formed by Taiyin and Taiyang.

This Martial Arts Evolutionary, to create a small inner world, would have to grasp the rules beyond the Golden Rules, utilizing the Five Elements rules of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, alongside the Space Rules, to hope to create a small inner world.

Nonetheless, no matter how you put it, the Seventh Rank Chapter which Lin Yuan currently opened has a tremendously lifted ceiling, and the evaluation from the Goddess of Wisdom definitely won’t be low.

…

A month later.

“This, this is the core spatial model?”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, strands of spatial force continuously intertwining, instantly forming a spatial model.

This spatial model, far more complicated than the basic spatial models by thousands to tens of thousands of times, just looking at it gives a sense of spatial transformations.

“The core spatial model, elucidating the essence of space rules, each type of core spatial model has a significant use. Systematic combinations of different core spatial models can also form abilities similar to innate divine abilities,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

For example, the combination of the first, thirteenth, sixteenth, and twenty-third core spatial models.

This combination will grant the ability of ‘Teleportation’.

Teleportation, a high-end application of space rules, is effective both in saving oneself and in pursuit.

With a total of seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two core spatial models theoretically, so many core spatial models can form countless space-based methods similar to ‘Teleportation’.

“Space rules, vast and limitless, even if one understands all seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two core spatial models, it does not mean they have fully mastered the entire space rules…”

Lin Yuan sighed.

The deeper his understanding of rules, the more Lin Yuan felt his own insignificance.

“Hmm?”

“Has the Yang Spirit already reached beneath the Eternal Spatial Rift?”

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something and looked toward a battlefield of Different Species.

As for the Yin Spirit? It had arrived three days earlier.

“Let’s check the accumulation speed of the World-Breaking Origin Force…”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, carefully feeling it.

“The speed hasn’t increased?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his brows furrowed.

The two Primordial Spirits were positioned under the Eternal Spatial Rifts in different battlefields.

The speed at which Lin Yuan accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force was still one filament every two hundred and ninety days.

“What’s the principle here?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat puzzled in his heart.

Whether it was the Door to the Myriad Realms seen by his true form or by the two Primordial Spirits, it was merely a projection of the true Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and then stopped dwelling on it.

This result had not caused him much impact.

“Let the Yin Spirit return.”

With a slight movement of Lin Yuan’s mind, the Yin Spirit began to leave the battlefield, returning to the Chikun Main Star.

Since there was no difference between having two Primordial Spirits and one, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t keep both on the battlefield of Different Species.

Keeping one Primordial Spirit by his side, he’d have more means to deal with things should the need arise.

…

Time passed in the world.

Months flew by in the blink of an eye.

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into his mind.

“I’ve accumulated two filaments of World-Breaking Origin Force…”

Lin Yuan looked toward the Door to the Myriad Realms, and with a slight sense, he knew the quantity of World-Breaking Origin Force.

With the Eternal Spatial Rift accelerating the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force, Lin Yuan did not immediately traverse after a filament was fully amassed.

Rather, he waited for some time.

After all, this incurred no loss for Lin Yuan, and it wouldn’t result in wasteful behavior with the World-Breaking Origin Force.

No matter how much time passed, the World-Breaking Origin Force accumulated at the Door to the Myriad Realms was stored there, waiting for Lin Yuan to use at any time.

“Let’s see which world this traversal leads to…”

Lin Yuan sent a thread of his consciousness into the Door to the Myriad Realms.

In a daze, this thread of Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirit traversed time and space, arriving before a vast world.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan tried to observe that world, his expression subtly changing.

“This world…”

The next moment, this thread of consciousness extinguished.

…

“The world of this traversal…”

In the outside world, Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

From the brief observation contact just now, Lin Yuan had obtained some information related to this traversal.

First was the duration of stay.

This traversal, Lin Yuan’s duration of stay would be six hundred years.

While the time that would pass in the Main World was one year.

That is to say, the ratio of time passage between the traversal world and the Main World.

Was six hundred to one.

Through the time ratio, Lin Yuan deduced that the world of this traversal was of a very high level, much higher even than the Immortal Tao World of his fifth traversal, though still far below the Main World.

Perhaps it was close to the Spirit Realm above the Immortal Tao World?

“Traverse.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while, making up his mind.

At the same time.

On the battlefield of Different Species.

Lin Yuanyang’s Yang Spirit began to leave the Eternal Spatial Rift.

Came to the Human Race Base on the battlefield, looking for a training room to enter into seclusion.

Once the traversal started, Lin Yuan’s consciousness would enter the Door to the Myriad Realms, losing awareness. Whether it was his true form or his Primordial Spirit, both would enter a state of slumber, naturally choosing a safe place.

“Begin.”

On the Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, and his consciousness and spirit all poured into the Door to the Myriad Realms.
